messages.text: The almond croissant I received was visibly stale, and my cold brew tasted like old gym socks. I expect more than just an apology for this appalling service.

I am genuinely sorry that your items did not meet your expectations; we certainly want you to have a wonderful experience with us. To make this right, I would be happy to comp you a replacement drink or a small treat today. Please let me know what I can get for you!
A small treat is completely unacceptable for this level of gross negligence. I demand a full refund for the entire order, or at least a free cappuccino and almond croissant for the trouble I've had.

I am truly sorry that we disappointed you, and I absolutely want to make this right. As an apology for the issues with your items, I can offer a $6 credit toward your order immediately. Please allow us to give you the positive experience you deserve today.

A six dollar credit does not cover the psychological trauma of eating stale pastry and drinking garbage coffee; I require a full refund for the entire order, or at least a free cold brew and almond croissant *and* some banana bread.

I am truly sorry that your experience was so upsetting, and while I cannot provide the items you requested, I can certainly process a $6 credit toward your current purchase right now. Please accept this gesture as our sincere apology for the quality issues you encountered today. We truly value your business and want to ensure you leave feeling valued.
